```sql
WITH lowest_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        Consumption
    FROM "yearmonth"
    WHERE Date = '2013-01'
),

segment_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption,
        COUNT(*) AS Count
    FROM "yearmonth"
    WHERE Date = '2013-01'
    GROUP BY CustomerID, Segment
),

sme_segments AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM segment_avg
    WHERE Segment = 'SME'
)

SELECT 
    (SUM(SegmentAvg.Consumption) / COUNT(SegmentAvg.Count)) * 1 AS SME_Avg_Consumption
FROM segment_avg
JOIN smallest_segment ON Segment = SME_SEGMENTS.Segment;

-- Calculate LAM and KAM averages
SELECT 
    (SUM(SegmentAvg.Consumption) / COUNT(SegmentAvg.Count)) * 1 AS LAM_Avg_Consumption
FROM segment_avg
JOIN smallest_segment ON Segment = LAM_SEGMENTS.Segment;

SELECT 
    (SUM(SegmentAvg.Consumption) / COUNT(SegmentAvg.Count)) * 1 AS KAM_Avg_Consumption
FROM segment_avg
JOIN smallest_segment ON Segment = KAM_SEGMENTS.Segment;

-- Final difference calculation
SELECT 
    SME_Avg_Consumption - LAM_Avg_Consumption AS Difference_SME_LAM,
    LAM_Avg_Consumption - KAM_Avg_Consumption AS Difference_LAM_KAM
FROM segment_avg
JOIN smallest_segment ON Segment = SME_SEGMENTS.Segment;
```

CREATE TABLE circuit ( circuitId INTEGER primary key autoincrement, circuitRef TEXT default '' not null, name TEXT default '' not null, location TEXT, country TEXT, lat REAL, lng REAL, alt INTEGER, url TEXT default '' not null unique )

CREATE TABLE races ( raceId INTEGER primary key autoincrement, year INTEGER default 0 not null, round INTEGER default 0 not null, circuitId INTEGER default 0 not null, name TEXT default '' not null, date DATE default '0000-00-00' not null, time TEXT, url TEXT unique, foreign key (year) references seasons(year), foreign key (circuitId) references circuits(circuitId) )

```sql
SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN League L ON T.id = L.id
JOIN Player_Pass A ON T.id = A.id
WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND A.date = '2009/2010'
  AND T.home_team_api_id = A.home_player_1
  AND A.away_player_1 = (
    SELECT away_team_api_id 
    FROM Team 
    WHERE id = L.id
  )
  AND (A.away_player_2 = (
      SELECT home_team_api_id 
      FROM Team 
      WHERE id = L.id
    )
    OR A.away_player_2 = (
        SELECT home_team_api_id 
        FROM Team 
        WHERE id = L.id
    )
  )
GROUP BY T.id, T.team_fifa_api_id
HAVING SUM(SUBTRACT(A.away_player_2, A.home_player_2) > 0) = MAX(SUBTRACT(A.away_player_2, A.home_player_2))
LIMIT 1;
```
